title: GitHub (fine-grained personal access token or GitHub App, read-only permissions)

checks.title: The organization requires two-factor authentication
checks.scope: Organization members on github.com; the factor kind is not visible.

checks.title: The default GITHUB_TOKEN is read-only and cannot approve pull requests
checks.scope: Organization default; a workflow can still ask for more with its own permissions block.

checks.title: Actions are limited to the organization's own or selected actions
checks.scope: Organization setting; the selected list itself is not reviewed.

checks.title: At most --github-max-owners members are organization owners
checks.scope: Organization owners only; repository admins are not counted.

checks.title: At most --github-max-outside-collaborators outside collaborators
checks.scope: Count only; what each collaborator can reach is not judged.

checks.title: The organization audit log is readable and not empty
checks.scope: GitHub Enterprise Cloud only; streaming to a SIEM is not visible.

checks.title: The default branch requires a pull request with at least one approving review
checks.scope: Classic branch protection or an active ruleset; admins who may bypass are not judged.

checks.title: The default branch dismisses stale approvals when new commits are pushed
checks.scope: Classic branch protection or an active ruleset.

checks.title: The default branch requires at least one status check to pass
checks.scope: That a check is required, not what it tests.

checks.title: The default branch blocks force pushes
checks.scope: Classic branch protection or an active ruleset.

checks.title: The default branch requires signed commits
checks.scope: Optional hardening; a fail here is advisory for most baselines.

checks.title: The repository has a CODEOWNERS file
checks.scope: Presence only; whether code-owner review is required is not judged.

checks.title: Secret scanning is enabled
checks.scope: Repository setting; shown to repository admins only.

checks.title: Secret scanning push protection is enabled
checks.scope: Repository setting; shown to repository admins only.

checks.title: Dependabot alerts are enabled
checks.scope: Dependency manifests GitHub can read; vendored code is not covered.

checks.title: No open critical or high Dependabot alert is older than --github-alert-days days
checks.scope: Open alerts only; dismissed alerts are not reviewed.

checks.title: Code scanning has produced at least one analysis
checks.scope: That an analysis exists, not its findings; skipped when GitHub Advanced Security is not licensed for a private repository.
